description: This file defines API endpoints for managing and retrieving sports highlight data within a FastAPI application. It includes routes for fetching a list of highlights, details of a specific highlight, and latest featured highlights, utilizing database repositories and schemas.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router object used to define API endpoints for highlights.

methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of highlights, optionally filtered by match ID.

methods.name: get_highlight_details( highlight_id: str, request: Request = None, db_session: AsyncSession = None )
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information of a specific highlight by its ID.

methods.description: Retrieves the latest featured highlights limited by the specified count.
